operator_context: Craig took asus-tuf-a16 offline for school and returned; these are operator shutdowns/restarts, not unexplained crashes.
handshake_warning: Generic once-per-process warning on both nodes; precise cause unobservable from retained logs. Self-dial is one possible cause in finish_auth, not proven.
